plants.name: Prunus mume
plants.description: Ume is one of the first trees to bloom as winter loosens its grip. Its bare branches fill with delicate, five-petaled blossoms that give off a sweet, spicy fragrance. Often the flowers open against the last patches of snow.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late January to early March, with peak bloom in mid to late February in much of Japan
plants.location: Japan, including Kyoto, Mito and the Izu Peninsula
plants.funFact: Ume blossoms appear weeks before cherry blossoms. In East Asian art and poetry they stand for perseverance, because they flower through the cold.

plants.name: Jacaranda mimosifolia
plants.description: Jacaranda is a tall tree with feathery, fern-like leaves. Its branches carry clusters of trumpet-shaped flowers, and the blooms fall to create a violet carpet on the ground.
plants.bloomingSeason: Mostly late spring to early summer, with some trees flowering again in late summer

plants.name: Protea cynaroides
plants.description: King Protea has the largest flower head in the protea family. It looks like a large crown of silky, pointed bracts around a center of fine, pale filaments. It grows wild on fynbos hillsides.
plants.bloomingSeason: Peak flowering is spring, from about September to November. Some blooms appear through summer and into late summer.
